messages.content: i want to write to my aunt, but it has been a long time and i keep trying to put everything into the first sentence.
you can begin with why you wanted to write now, then choose one thing to tell her. the first sentence does not have to hold the whole letter.
can you give me a start? i want her to know i have been thinking about her.
i have been thinking about you and wanted to write. how have you been?
now i want to tell her i started reading a book she once showed me.
i have been thinking about you and wanted to write. i started reading the book you showed me and remembered our conversation about it.
can i keep the question about how she is?
i have been thinking about you and wanted to write. how have you been? i started reading the book you showed me and remembered our conversation about it.
does that sound like a whole letter already?
it can be a good start, but you can add what you thought about the book or something else from your life if you want. you do not need to say everything at once.
i just want to send a short letter, not make it a whole task.
then those few sentences can be enough, with a short goodbye in your own words.
give a kind last sentence without saying i will visit on a day i have not chosen.
i would like to hear how you are doing when you have time to write.
now only give the first sentence again.
i have been thinking about you and wanted to write.
is near the table the same as next to the table?
not always. near can leave more space open. next to often makes the two things sound very close, with little between them.
give that answer with close and less specific.
next to often makes the two things sound very close, with little between them. near is less specific.
now put a chair next to a table in one sentence.
the chair is next to the table.
if i put a cup on the table, is the cup next to the chair too?
the cup is on the table. that does not tell us which side of the table it is on or how close it is to the chair.
keep it simple.
the cup is on the table. that does not tell us which side of the table it is on or how close it is to the chair.
can on and near both be true?
yes. the cup can be on the table and near the chair.
now give only a sentence with under instead.
the cup is under the table.
does changing on to under change the object?
no. it changes the place of the cup, not what object it is.
only give the chair sentence again.
the chair is next to the table.
someone at work asked about the book i was carrying, and we had a short talk. i had not talked with her much before.
what was it like to find a small thing you could talk about together?
it was easy. i thought i would need a very large story about my life, but the book was enough.
sometimes a small thing you both know can give a conversation a place to start. you do not need a large story about your life before talking to someone.
say it simply.
a small thing you both know can be enough to start a conversation.
can you help me write two sentences about it?
someone at work asked about the book i was carrying. we had a short conversation, and it felt more easy than i had thought it would.
give only the sentence with more easy.
we had a short conversation, and it felt more easy than i had thought it would.
now put both sentences together.
someone at work asked about the book i was carrying. we had a short conversation, and it felt more easy than i had thought it would.
does that make us close friends already?
no. it was a good small conversation, but one talk does not tell us the whole story of how well you will know each other later.
give a warm reply without choosing what happens later.
it sounds like a good first conversation to have.
write a story about a child making a picture for a parent. the parent should like the care behind it, even though some lines are not how the child wanted them.

a child sat at the table making a picture of the house for his mother. he wanted the tree near the door, but the first line went too far across the page. he thought about starting again. then he looked at the paper and chose to make the tree larger instead. by the time his mother came home, the tree was the most large thing in the picture. he showed it to her and explained why it grew so large. she listened and asked about the small person near the window. he said it was her, waiting for him after school. she said that was the part she liked best. the child still saw the line he had not wanted to make, but he also saw a picture that told his mother something kind.
give just the part about how he made the tree and what she liked.

he wanted the tree near the door, but the first line went too far across the page. he made the tree larger instead. when his mother came home, he explained why it grew so large, and she said the small person by the window was the part she liked best.
why did the mother like that part?
the child had made it her, waiting for him after school. it was a part about their time together.
did he have to say every line was right to give the picture?
no. he could give it with the story of how he made it.
now make the last idea a sentence in his voice.
not every line is how i wanted it, but i made this picture for you.
only give a short warm reply from the mother.
thank you. i like the care you put into it.
what question asks for three hours rather than three books?
how long asks about time, as in how long did you read? how many books asks for a number of books.
can how many ask about hours too?
yes. how many hours did you read asks for a number of hours.
then are how long and how many hours both possible?
yes. both can work for time in hours. how long can also take a reply like all afternoon or a little while.
now ask about the number of pages instead.
how many pages did you read?
i read four. does that tell you how long it took?
no. four pages gives how much you read, not how much time you spent.
what if the pages were short?
people can read fast or slowly. short pages do not give a specific time by themselves.
say it with fast and slow.
people can read fast or slowly. the number of pages alone does not give the time.
ask only the time question now.
how long did you read?
an hour. answer in a full sentence in my voice.
i read for an hour.
my friend told me again that we chose the park, not the library. i forgot, and now i feel wrong about it.
you can thank her for telling you again and use the place she gave. a detail you forgot does not mean you do not care.
give a simple reply i can use.
you can say thank you for telling me again. i remember now that we chose the park.
can i say sorry without making it a very large thing?
yes. sorry, i forgot the place. thank you for telling me again can be enough.
what if she says it is fine?
then you can use her answer and keep the plan moving, rather than keep saying it must be a problem.
write a short reply after it is fine.
thank you. i will see you at the park.
did i tell you what day?
no. you gave the place, but not a day in this conversation.
then do not add today.
i will keep the reply without a day: thank you. i will see you at the park.
just give that message again.
thank you. i will see you at the park.
here is a story. a mother called her son before lunch. after lunch, the son called his sister. who got the first call?
the son got the first call, from his mother.
who made the last call?
the son made the last call to his sister.
did the sister call the mother?
not in the story you gave. the two calls were mother to son, then son to sister.
now tell it from the voice of the son.
my mother called me before lunch. after lunch, i called my sister.
what if the sister is telling the story?
if they have the same mother, she can say: my mother called my brother before lunch. after lunch, he called me.
can you know from the first story that they have the same mother?
not for sure. the first story only said the son had a sister. i should ask if that family detail is important.
ask the question.
do the brother and sister have the same mother in this story?
yes. now give the sentence in her voice again.
my mother called my brother before lunch. after lunch, he called me.
who is he in that last sentence?
her brother, who made the call after lunch.
i want my room to feel different, but i do not want to move every object today. i have a table, a chair, and books near the window.
you could choose one small change first. what do you most want to be different: space to walk, light for reading, or how the books are kept?
light for reading. the chair is behind a large plant, and i cannot see the page well there.
then you could try moving the chair to a place where you can see the page well, without changing the whole room.
say only the part about moving the chair.
you could try moving the chair to a place where you can see the page well.
what if that place is in the way of the door?
then it would not work for leaving the chair there. you need a place where you can read and still use the door.
can you choose the right place without seeing the room?
not a specific place for sure. i can help you think about the light and space, but you know the real room.
what one question should i ask myself while trying the chair in another place?
can i read clearly here without being in the way of the door?
now only give the idea about one small change.
try one place for the chair before moving everything else.
if i say i have already had lunch, can i still want to sit with my family while they eat?
yes. already had lunch says you had that meal before now. it does not mean you cannot sit with other people at the table.
now make a kind reply to someone who asks if i want lunch.
thank you, but i have already had lunch. i would still like to sit with you for a while.
does already mean i ate too much?
no. it is about when you had lunch, not how much food you had.
give that answer with not how much.
it is about when you ate, not how much.
what if i am hungry again?
you can have had lunch before and still be hungry now. already does not say you will never want food again.
now make a question about whether my brother has had lunch.
has your brother already had lunch?
answer no, not yet.
no, he has not had lunch yet.
why has with brother and have with i?
with your brother in that sentence, use has. with i, use have.
only give the example where i sit with the family after eating.
i have already had lunch, but i would still like to sit with you for a while.
i started a story but stopped after one page. i do not know the end yet.
you have a start and a page to work with. what part of the story do you already know?
a woman goes to visit her father, but she finds an old photo before leaving. i want the photo to change something, but not make impossible things happen.
it could change what she wants to ask him about. a photo can bring up a memory or a question without changing the real world around her.
what question could the photo give her?
she might see a person she does not know and want to ask her father who it is.
can you write that as the next two sentences of the story?
in the photo, her father stood near someone she did not know. she put it in her book so she could ask him about it during the visit.
give those sentences again without changing them.
in the photo, her father stood near someone she did not know. she put it in her book so she could ask him about it during the visit.
does that finish the whole story for me?
no. it gives a reason to carry the photo into the visit, but leaves what her father says for you to choose.
then do not add his answer yet.
okay. his answer can stay open until you choose it.
only give the question she could ask him.
who is this person in the photo with you?
what is different between i moved everything and i moved something?
everything can be all the things in the group you are talking about. something can be one or more things without giving a specific object.
say it with can be.
something can be one or more things, without giving a specific object. everything can be all the things in the group.
if i moved a book but left the cup, can i say i moved everything on the table?
not if the cup was on the table too. you left one of those things there.
can i say i moved something on the table?
yes. you moved the book, so something is true.
now i move the cup too, and there was nothing else on the table. can i say i moved everything?
yes. if the book and cup were the only things on the table, you moved everything from it.
does that mean the whole house is empty?
no. everything was about the table in this conversation, not every object in the house.
make that difference clear with a full sentence.
i moved everything off the table, but other things are still in the house.
only ask whether the table is empty now.
is the table empty now?
yes. give a short answer in your voice.
yes. the table is empty now.
write a story about a child teaching a parent a simple game. the parent should ask questions, and the child should not need to know every answer right away.

a child wanted to show her father a game with a ball. she explained where to stand and what to do first. he listened, then asked what happened if the ball went past the line. she stopped to think because she had only learned the game that morning. instead of making up an answer, she said she needed to check. they looked at the note her friend had given her and found the rule together. then they tried again. the father did not mind waiting for the answer, and the child found that teaching did not mean she had to remember everything without looking. after playing for a while, they both understood the game better and needed fewer questions.
give only the last sentence.
after playing for a while, they both understood the game better and needed fewer questions.
why did the child stop to check?
she did not know the answer about the ball going past the line.
did her need to check mean she could not teach any part of the game?
no. she knew some parts and checked another. that did not make all her teaching wrong.
give the same idea without no at the start.
she knew some parts and checked another. that did not make all her teaching wrong.
now only give what she could say when she does not know.
i am not sure. let us look at the rule together.
my friend says meet at the front door, but there is a door near the tree and a door near the station. i do not know which one she is talking about.
you can ask for a detail that keeps them apart, such as the side of the building or something near the door.
write one question using the tree near one door.
do you mean the door near the tree?
she says no, the one near the station. now write a reply saying i understand.
okay. i will meet you at the door near the station.
does that say the station door or the building door near the station?
it could be more clear. if you mean a door of a specific building, keep the building in the message.
the building is the school. write it that way.
okay. i will meet you at the school door near the station.
can i leave out the tree now?
yes. the station detail is enough if that makes the door clear between you.
what if i ask you to add an hour but i have not given one?
i should ask what hour you chose, rather than make one up.
ask only that question.
what time have you chosen to meet?
can can mean i know how to do something and also someone says it is okay to do it?
yes. i can read can be about knowing how to read. can i read here can ask whether reading there is okay.
use a more clear example with a child and a book.
the child can read the book can be about what the child knows how to do. can the child take the book home can ask whether taking it home is okay.
what if the answer is yes, she can? which meaning is it?
you need the question and context. a short answer can use either meaning, so you need to know what was asked.
say it with the question helps choose the meaning.
the question helps choose the meaning. yes, she can answers what that question asked.
now ask about knowing how to read without making it a request to take anything.
does the child know how to read?
now ask about taking the book home.
is it okay for the child to take the book home?
can those have different answers?
yes. a child can know how to read while a specific book still needs to stay in the room.
give only that example with specific.
a child can know how to read while a specific book still needs to stay in the room.
the day was busy, but i had dinner with my cousin and it felt like a calm end.
what made the dinner feel calm for you?
we did not try to talk about every problem. we just made food and told each other small things about the day.
it sounds like time together without a plan for every problem.
give that reply with fewer words.
it sounds like time together without a plan for every problem.
can you write a few sentences about it without saying every problem in my life is gone?
i had a busy day, but dinner with my cousin felt calm. we made food and told each other small things about the day without trying to talk about every problem.
keep it as close as you can to my own words and give that again.
i had a busy day, but dinner with my cousin felt calm. we made food and told each other small things about the day without trying to talk about every problem.
that is enough. no more questions.
okay. it sounds like a good quiet part of the day.
now only wish me a good evening.
i hope you have a good evening.
